about_the_game:
Japanese-style Fantasy × Fairy Tale Narrative Exploration ADV

Main story is fully voiced in Japanese.

Background Story

The wandering shrine maiden Eve heard the call from a deity in her dreams.

When she woke up, she decided to follow the guidance in her dream and made her way to Mt. Kirigakure, a mountain veiled in haze where the deity also resides.

Following her intuition, she crossed the sacred barrier and reached the shrine in the depths of Mt. Kirigakure.

There, she encountered the concealed Deity, Shil.

He is a deity, yet also a prisoner.

She is a wanderer, yet also a guide.

This is a tale of the nameless deity and a wandering shrine maiden…

Game Description

This is a narrative-driven exploration game set in a traditional Japanese aesthetic.

As a short standalone experience, the estimated playtime is approximately 1 to 2 hours.

The game features simple keyboard controls and QTE interactions — as players make choices and complete events, the Story log updates with the next objective while recording all past actions.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows® 8.1/10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: "Bride of Ryujin Another Story: The Tale of the Sacred Bell" is an ADV that blends Japanese-style fantasy with fairytale storytelling. The game tells the story of a nameless deity and a wandering shrine maiden. Players will join them as they uncover stories buried deep in Mt. Kirigakure.

Japanese*, Traditional Chinese, English
*languages with full audio support
